name: openFDA
summary: US Food and Drug Administration public data: drug, device and food adverse events, recalls, drug labels, NDC directory, approvals and 510(k) clearances.

api_key.description: Optional free openFDA API key (open.fda.gov/apis/authentication). Sent as the api_key query parameter; raises the daily limit.

notes: Keyless works: 240 requests per minute and 1,000 per day per IP. With a key: 240 per minute and 120,000 per day per key.
Every endpoint takes the same search, sort, count, limit and skip parameters; field names differ per dataset (see each endpoint's searchable fields page).
skip+limit paging stops at about 26,000 hits. Beyond that, sort without skip and follow the Link header's rel="Next" URL (search_after) until it disappears.
count returns value/term counts instead of records; use the .exact field variant to count whole phrases rather than single words.

endpoints.name: Search drug adverse event reports
endpoints.summary: Drug adverse event reports: patient, drugs taken and reactions.

search.description: field:term clauses; +AND+ requires both, a space or + between clauses means either. No field searches all fields.

count.description: Field whose unique values to count (top 1000); add .exact to count whole phrases.

skip.description: Records to skip, for paging; at most 25000.
